notes: Modified cash basis school district; all funds including School Nutrition are shown as governmental funds (no proprietary statement), so business_type is null. Receipts and disbursements from the Total Governmental Funds column of the p4 statement. The p4 'General Fund' column pools General (p6-8), Depreciation (p9) and Employee Benefit (p10) funds. Statement 'Non-Revenue Receipts' 209,714 split using the fund schedules (General 15,939 + 750 + 1,439; Depreciation transfer 162,000; Nutrition 5,961; Special Building 23,625 - all tie exactly); the 162,000 is recorded as transfers_in and so is not in the receipts list. The 55,500 General to Activities transfer nets to zero in the p4 total column (shown separately below the excess), and is recorded in detail as other financing. 'Debt Service' 683,379 split per Bond Fund p13 (principal 575,000, interest 107,005, debt related expenses 1,374). Identity: 8,184,359 + (14,455,162 - 162,000) - 13,366,908 + 162,000 = 9,272,613. Beginning cash = 'Restated Fund Balances - Beg.' 8,184,359 (cash basis). Balance sheet: Statement of Net Position (only governmental activities column; no liabilities printed). Detail: General Fund budget schedule p6-8 records actuals only (original/final budget printed only as totals: receipts 10,999,950, disbursements 14,012,327); fund schedules for all other funds recorded; combining schedule p5 not recorded to avoid double counting.
